Check whether a checkpoint has already been saved

Source: R/checkpoint.R
step_done.Rd

Returns TRUE if a checkpoint file exists for name. Use this at the start of a step to skip expensive work that has already been done.

Usage

step_done(name, dir = .checkpoint_dir(), max_age = Inf)

Arguments

name

Character. The checkpoint name to check.

dir

Character. Checkpoint directory.

max_age

Numeric. Optional maximum age in seconds. If supplied and the checkpoint is older than this, it is treated as absent (returns FALSE), so a stale checkpoint from a previous run won't short-circuit a fresh one. Default Inf (never expires).

Value

Logical. TRUE if a usable checkpoint exists, FALSE otherwise.

See also

checkpoint(), resume_pipeline(), clear_checkpoint()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
if (step_done("nga_fetch")) {
  df <- resume_pipeline("nga_fetch")
} else {
  df <- get_data("NGA"); checkpoint(df, "nga_fetch")
}

# Ignore checkpoints older than one hour
if (step_done("nga_fetch", max_age = 3600)) { }
} # }
